data.reply:
SCAM: this message shows the signs of a scam.
Why: it asks for a code, PIN or personal details; it promises a prize, loan or easy money; it claims to come from a bank or government body.
What to do: do not click the link, call the number or pay. If you already shared card details or an OTP, call your bank on the number printed on your card now.
Rakshaka never asks for your OTP, PIN or NIC.
